name: The Battle for Alterac
summary: Voggah Deathgrip sends you into Alterac Valley to defeat the dwarven general Vanndar Stormpike. His defeat is the purpose of this undertaking.

sections.title: A General in Alterac
sections.body: In the Alterac Mountains, Voggah Deathgrip sends you toward Alterac Valley. The dwarven general Vanndar Stormpike is your target, and Voggah awaits your return.

faq.q: Who sends me to Alterac Valley?
faq.answer: Voggah Deathgrip sends you into Alterac Valley to defeat Vanndar Stormpike.
The target is Vanndar Stormpike, a dwarven general.
You are sent into Alterac Valley.

faq.q: Who am I meant to return to?
faq.answer: After defeating Vanndar Stormpike, you are to return to Voggah Deathgrip in the Alterac Mountains.

attribution: In-game quest text: The Battle for Alterac
